response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance item (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100) making it ineligible for return. This highest-priority rule dominates the standard 30-day window rule (RET-007), which would not even apply since it requires final_sale == False. The item is not defective, so RET-020 does not apply, and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
